import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    
    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;
        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }
    
    static class Dinic {
        final long flow_inf = (long)1e18;
        ArrayList<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
        int n, m = 0;
        int s, t;
        int[] level;
        int[] ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        
        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }
        
        void add_edge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(m);
            adj.get(u).add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }
        
        boolean bfs() {
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj.get(v)) {
                    FlowEdge edge = edges.get(id);
                    if (edge.cap - edge.flow < 1)
                        continue;
                    if (level[edge.u] != -1)
                        continue;
                    level[edge.u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(edge.u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }
        
        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0)
                return 0;
            if (v == t)
                return pushed;
            for (int cid = ptr[v]; cid < adj.get(v).size(); cid++) {
                ptr[v] = cid;
                int id = adj.get(v).get(cid);
                FlowEdge edge = edges.get(id);
                int u = edge.u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edge.cap - edge.flow < 1)
                    continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edge.cap - edge.flow));
                if (tr == 0)
                    continue;
                edge.flow += tr;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }
        
        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                level[s] = 0;
                q.add(s);
                if (!bfs())
                    break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, flow_inf);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    f += pushed;
                }
            }
            return f;
        }
    }
    
    static int n, t;
    static String[] sci = new String[15];
    static String[] cap = new String[15];
    static int[][] dis = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] dis2 = new int[15][15];
    
    static boolean isvalid(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n) return false;
        if (sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || sci[x].charAt(y) == 'Z') return false;
        return true;
    }
    
    static void bfs1(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++)
                dis[i][j] = -1;
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] u = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int vx = u[0] + dx[i];
                int vy = u[1] + dy[i];
                if (isvalid(vx, vy) && dis[vx][vy] == -1) {
                    dis[vx][vy] = 1 + dis[u[0]][u[1]];
                    q.add(new int[]{vx, vy});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dis[i][j] == -1)
                    dis[i][j] = 1000000000;
            }
        }
    }
    
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
    
    static int pos(int tt, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < tt) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        
        if (tt >= t) return 0;
        
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= tt) return 0;
        
        if (dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y];
        
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];
            
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n)
                continue;
            if (yy < 0 || yy >= n)
                continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y') continue;
            if (sci[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            
            if (pos(tt + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) {
                dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        dp[tt][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < 12; m++)
                            dp[i][j][k][l][m] = -1;
        
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sci[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            cap[i] = sc.nextLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    bfs1(i, j);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        ArrayList<int[]> scList = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<int[]> cpList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sci[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && sci[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && sci[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    scList.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (cap[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && cap[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && cap[i].charAt(j) != '0') {
                    cpList.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        
        Dinic flow = new Dinic(scList.size() + cpList.size() + 2, 0, scList.size() + cpList.size() + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < scList.size(); i++) {
            long c = sci[scList.get(i)[0]].charAt(scList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(0, i + 1, c);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < cpList.size(); i++) {
            long c = cap[cpList.get(i)[0]].charAt(cpList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            flow.add_edge(scList.size() + 1 + i, scList.size() + cpList.size() + 1, c);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < scList.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < cpList.size(); j++) {
                if (pos(0, scList.get(i)[0], scList.get(i)[1], cpList.get(j)[0], cpList.get(j)[1]) == 1) {
                    flow.add_edge(i + 1, scList.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow.flow());
    }
}
